concept.title: Motor status tab
concept.shortdesc: The Motor Status tab displays the health of nine motor components/faults and their overall performance.

conbody.p: The Motor Status tab displays the health of nine motor components/faults and their overall performance. A status indicator to the left of each item and a health index indicates whether a fault exists.

The health index represents an evaluation of the state of a component. It ranges from 0 to 10. If the index is closer to 0, it implies that the condition of the component is bad. If it is closer to 10, the condition of the component is good.
conbody.note: Note: Depending on the severity of the fault (health index), the timeline of the correction action will change. In case of high severity fault, the action will be required “as soon as possible”.

Note: A component that needs maintenance is displayed with a yellow status indicator and a failed component is displayed with a red status indicator. In both situations, the application suggests the precise course of action to be taken.
